source.document: Volkswagen Group service information (VW Body Repair Manual, rear radar / Lane Change Assist, Peripheral Camera System Calibration -VAS 721 001-).
source.note: Audi uses the same underlying VW Group service information. Calibration procedures and triggers are the same across the VW Group. No published parking sensor calibration or occupant classification calibration at this time — those toggles auto-off when VW/Audi is selected.

general_requirements: VW/Audi calibrations follow the procedures in the VW Group body repair manual. Triggers are specified per-component rather than in a standalone position statement.

triggers: Adaptive cruise control module / radar sensor is replaced
Adaptive cruise control module / radar sensor is removed and installed
Radiator support is set to the service position
Radiator support is replaced
Adjustments to the rear toe / thrust angle are made
Changes to the vehicle's ride height are made
Front camera is replaced
Windshield is replaced or removed
No or incorrect basic setting / adaptation fault is stored in the event memory
Adjustments to the rear toe / thrust angle are performed
Repairs are made to the chassis that influence body height
Level control system sensor is readapted on vehicles with damping regulation

components.component: Rear Radar (Lane Change Assist / Side Assist)
components.location: Behind rear bumper, left and right
components.calibration_note: Per VW: the rear radar must be calibrated after every removal and installation on vehicles with Lane Change Assist.
triggers: Rear radar is removed and installed
Rear radar is replaced
Rear bumper is removed and installed

components.component: Peripheral Camera System (Surround View / Area View / Top View)
components.location: Four cameras: front grille/bumper, rear, and left/right outer mirrors
components.calibration_note: Calibration performed with VAS 721 001 calibration system. Also required after wheel alignments and any change in vehicle standing height (>5 mm on one axle or >10 mm overall).
triggers: One or more cameras is replaced
Peripheral Camera Control Module -J928- is replaced
Peripheral Camera Control Module -J928- software is flashed
Data set is recorded on the Peripheral Camera Control Module -J928-
Repair work is performed on components in which a camera is installed, or that influence the location of the camera
Wheel alignment is performed
The overlap range of individual cameras is adjusted
Standing height of one axle changes by more than 5 mm
Standing height of the entire vehicle changes by more than 10 mm
